name: graphviz-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `graphviz`, a pure-Python interface to the Graphviz graph drawing
software: `Graph` and `Digraph` objects that assemble DOT source code (nodes, edges, attribute
statements, subgraphs, quoting and escaping of identifiers and labels), a `Source` class for
verbatim DOT strings and files, and wrappers that save the source, render and pipe it through the
Graphviz layout command, run the `unflatten` preprocessor, report the installed Graphviz version
and display graphs in Jupyter. The Graphviz command-line tools are installed in this environment.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the graphviz package and its user documentation: every module under graphviz/, together with README.rst, the documentation pages index, manual (with the user-guide pages it includes: installation, basic_usage, formats, piped_output, jupyter_notebooks, styling, attributes, node_ports, escapes, quoting, subgraphs_and_clusters, engines, neato_no_op, unflatten, custom_dot, raw_dot, existing_files and integration_with_viewers, and the shared link targets in _links.rst), examples (with the example scripts under examples/ that it includes) and api, and the module, class and function docstrings in the package, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not
